references.text: God describes how he carried Israel on eagle's wings out of Egypt, the same image used for an eagle carrying its young
The Lord protects Jerusalem like birds hovering over their young, similar to the image of an eagle hovering over its nest
Those who wait on the Lord shall renew their strength and lift up their wings like eagles, connected to the eagle image as a symbol of God's care
The cherubim spread out their wings to cover the mercy seat, similar to the image of an eagle spreading its wings over its young
Ruth seeks refuge under the Lord's wings, the same image of God's protection that an eagle gives its young
David asks to be hidden in the shadow of God's wings, related to the image of an eagle protecting its young
People seek refuge under the shadow of God's wings, the same theme of protection as an eagle over its young
God covers with his feathers and gives refuge under his wings, a direct parallel to the eagle image
Jesus wishes to gather Jerusalem's children as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, similar to the image of a bird caring for its young
Jesus wishes to gather Jerusalem's children as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, a parallel to the eagle image of God's protective care
